label: x32 pattern test, seed 6 (fails the controller-clock constraint in nextpnr's model), load 2

reproducible_identity.note: a rebuild with the same inputs and tools reproduces these; bitstream.sha256 covers the .bit header with xc7frames2bit's date and time and identifies only this one file (the one to flash)

run.t0_note: every *_s value is host seconds after t0 on one monotonic clock

clock.note: fit of the S lines' clock count over the host arrival times; the arrival jitter of the USB serial bridge (milliseconds) bounds its precision

notes: pattern_test_*_MBps: region bytes over the phase's controller clocks (first request presented to last ack), with the in-order single-master access of this test, refresh and row changes included; it is not the stage-2 throughput measurement

min_write_to_read: every burst's read request is accepted at least hold + bursts - 1 controller clocks after its write request (all writes are acknowledged before the first read, at most one request per clock); no longer retention is claimed
a pass covers the burst addresses 0 .. bursts-1 once for write and once for read-back; the counts are per pass, bursts and 64-bit words counted once however many bits are wrong
